How to be the best man
at a wedding

1. Handle the logistics

Rings, timing, cars.
The groom shouldn't think about it.

2. Keep the speech short

Three minutes. One story.
Nothing embarrassing.

3. Stay sober enough
to help

You're on duty until
the last guest leaves.

4. Get people dancing

First one on the floor.
The room follows.

5. Know the couple's story

How they met, what they love.
Write it down early.
